topic: Day 50 — reel — You build self-trust the same way you build trust with anyone else
text: Self-trust follows the same [mechanism]. Kept promises.
caption:
Breaking a promise to yourself repeatedly erodes your own credibility with yourself, the same way it would with anyone else.
